question: Should pending Skill Workshop approvals require the proposal version captured at approval-prompt creation, while direct ID-only service and CLI lifecycle calls remain compatible?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes the user-facing approval contract to fail closed when a proposal changes; code review alone cannot determine whether that product and compatibility tradeoff is the desired permanent behavior.

options.title: Accept version-bound pending approvals
options.body: Merge the version binding after final current-main and CI refresh, preserving the documented ID-only compatibility outside the approval gate.

options.title: Keep pending approvals ID-only
options.body: Narrow the PR to previews and retain the existing pending-approval lifecycle contract without proposal-version enforcement.

options.title: Defer the feature contract
options.body: Pause the PR until a Skill Workshop owner specifies the desired approval and review semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept version-bound pending approvals
recommendation.body: Merge the version binding after final current-main and CI refresh, preserving the documented ID-only compatibility outside the approval gate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the adjacent Skill Workshop approval resolver makes this the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available from the supplied context.
